name: Codex (ChatGPT)
description: Adds the Codex CLI as a provider, in two ways. As a TTY session it runs the real interactive Codex TUI in a pane, the same as Claude's — its own interface, its own approval prompts, which the cockpit cannot see into. As an SDK session it speaks the persistent `codex app-server` protocol and has an in-band permission channel; configure sandbox, effort and approval-policy per profile so a spawned session can actually run unattended. Requires the codex CLI installed and authenticated (`codex login`) on the machine running Cockpit.
author: Cockpit
